profile.title: Professional Profile
profile.description: I'm a Full Stack web developer with a particular interest in frontend development, design, and user experience. I work with technologies such as React, Next.js, Node.js, and Express, combining modern interfaces with REST APIs, authentication, and databases. My goal is to develop complete, functional, and scalable web applications that combine design, technology, and good development practices.
profile.quote: I'm passionate about turning ideas into intuitive and accessible digital experiences.
profile.locationDescription: I'm based in Buenos Aires City, Argentina. I'm looking to join a team where I can contribute my knowledge, collaborate on projects, and continue growing professionally.
